title: SimplyServers
description: This plugin aims to help all server owners with their struggle of finding plugins to add that can help improve the quality of life for most players, this plugin also has a customizable config.yml file for server owners to turn on and off certain settings
body:
Description:

Ever feel like Minecraft PvP feels “sluggish” or unresponsive when you’re spamming hits? Most servers skip over the knockback from fast consecutive hits, especially with axes, making combat feel less dynamic.

FastHit KB / Stun restores that classic PvP feel by ensuring every hit applies knockback, even during rapid attacks. Now, players can land consecutive hits and see their target stagger naturally — without changing the damage.

Features:

✅ Forced Knockback: Every hit counts. Even fast spamming attacks will push targets.

✅ Weapon Agnostic: Works with swords, axes, or any weapon.

✅ Classic PvP Feel: Restores the old-school PvP combat mechanics for more responsive fights.

✅ Configurable Strength: Server owners can adjust knockback force to suit their gameplay.

✅ Optional Effects: Add sounds or particles for a satisfying combat feedback.

Why you need it:

On most servers, rapid hits often feel ineffective because the second or third hit doesn’t push players back. This plugin fixes that, making PvP more skill-based and fun — landing hits actually feels powerful again!
